calendar.note: Year zero is the Concord Compact, chosen for shared commercial recordkeeping rather than any species' religious or national calendar. Absolute Earth-equivalent dating remains intentionally unset.

eras.name: The Contact Generations
eras.summary: Independent civilizations establish reliable contact over several generations. Trade begins as cautious state and scientific exchange before private carriers become common.

eras.name: The Standards Period
eras.summary: Commercial incompatibilities become more expensive than political disagreements. Concord grows as neutral exchange ground; cargo, docking, pressure and identification standards are negotiated.

eras.name: Commercial Expansion
eras.summary: Mixed-species manufacturers and carriers spread. New Houston, Iron Gate, Hesperus, Bradbury and Pelagos mature into specialized economies linked by dependable freight.

eras.name: The Outer Buildout
eras.summary: Tidemark, Foundry and Port Meridian become economically permanent. Survey and freight networks push beyond the mature core.

eras.name: The Current Frontier
eras.summary: Waystation becomes permanent, Lastlight develops into the principal outward staging point and Talos enters a mineral-driven boom.

events.name: First Sustained Exchange
events.summary: Early contact networks become regular enough that crews and cargo can be planned months ahead rather than treated as singular expeditions.

events.name: Concord Exchange Founded
events.summary: A neutral commercial settlement is established to handle multispecies transfer, arbitration and incompatible cargo standards.

events.name: Concord Compact
events.summary: Major trading governments and commercial bodies adopt a shared framework for navigation identifiers, docking liability and commercial records. The event becomes year zero of the Interstellar Common Era.

events.name: Standard Cargo Unit Formalized
events.summary: The SCU becomes the dominant interstellar freight-volume standard after competing container systems repeatedly create costly transfer delays.

events.name: Roosevelt Commercial Yards Open
events.summary: New Houston's first large independent yards begin combining components from multiple engineering traditions instead of serving a single national or species standard.

events.name: First Iron Gate Heavy Keel
events.summary: A Kesh-founded orbital yard demonstrates that very large commercial hulls can be built more cheaply away from Keshar's high gravity.

events.name: Hesperus Becomes Net Food Exporter
events.summary: Agricultural expansion and imported Vey environmental methods turn Hesperus into a major regional food supplier.

events.name: Pelagos Joint Charter
events.summary: Long-standing Human and Vey settlements adopt a shared planetary commercial charter, later cited as an early durable mixed-species colonial government.

events.name: Carver Habitat Wave
events.summary: High metal demand funds a generation of rotating habitats, converting temporary extraction camps into permanent communities.

events.name: Bradbury Institute Compact
events.summary: Several Human and Ilyan research institutions pool freight, safety and laboratory infrastructure, accelerating the world's growth as a research center.

events.name: Meridian Fuel Depot Commissioned
events.summary: A utilitarian refueling depot opens at a route convergence. Nobody involved describes it as the foundation of a future city.

events.name: Foundry Deepworks Expansion
events.summary: New freight elevators and geothermal works make large-scale subsurface manufacturing economically competitive with inner-system factories.

events.name: Tidemark Platform Chain Completed
events.summary: A network of floating industrial platforms creates reliable large-scale extraction despite the world's lack of conventional landing terrain.

events.name: Port Meridian Passes One Million Residents
events.summary: The former depot is formally recognized as a major permanent settlement rather than a service installation.

events.name: Waystation Gets a Permanent Registry
events.summary: Residents successfully petition for permanent settlement status. The name Waystation survives despite repeated proposals for something more dignified.

events.name: Lastlight Survey Base Founded
events.summary: A multispecies survey base is established at the practical edge of dependable commercial support.

events.name: Talos Deposit Confirmation
events.summary: Independent assays confirm rare-mineral concentrations high enough to justify rapid industrial settlement.

events.name: Game Start
events.summary: Talos is still absorbing equipment faster than infrastructure can handle it, while Lastlight-supported surveys continue beyond the commercial network.
